description: This file defines the OrderedSet class, a custom ordered set implementation similar to collections.OrderedDict, with various set operations and internal methods.

classes.name: OrderedSet
classes.description: A custom insertion-ordered set implementation supporting set operations and iteration.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes an OrderedSet, optionally from an iterable.

methods.name: _from_dict
methods.description: Creates an OrderedSet from a dictionary input.

methods.name: __contains__
methods.description: Checks if an element is in the set.

methods.name: __iter__
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the set elements.

methods.name: __len__
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the set.

methods.name: __reversed__
methods.description: Returns a reversed iterator over the set.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds an element to the set.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all elements from the set.

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Removes and returns an arbitrary element.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Returns a shallow copy of the set.

methods.name: difference
methods.description: Returns the difference with other iterables.

methods.name: difference_update
methods.description: Removes elements found in other iterables.

methods.name: intersection_update
methods.description: Keeps only elements found in other iterables.

methods.name: issubset
methods.description: Checks if set is subset of another iterable.

methods.name: issuperset
methods.description: Checks if set is superset of another iterable.

methods.name: symmetric_difference
methods.description: Returns symmetric difference with another iterable.
